searchText: all nimbus hosts, except `nimbus-reth-1` I am going to delete `beacon_kzg_verification_data_column_single_seconds` from the beacon metrics specs. If I'm not wrong, `single` kzg is used only in LH, other clients use `batch`. So, no need to add it to the specs. Please, let me know if any other clients use it and want to see it in the specs. Custody groups are ready on Teku, `engine_getBlobsV2` is waiting for clients' implementation [beacon metrics specs PR #14](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14): ``` - beacon_custody_groups (Gauge) - beacon_custody_groups_backfilled (Gauge) - beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_requests_total (Counter) - beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_responses_total (Counter) - beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_runtime_seconds (Histogram) ``` Sunnyside Devnet Updates - 05/30

excerpts.author: sibkatya
excerpts.content:
Custody groups are ready on Teku, `engine_getBlobsV2` is waiting for clients' implementation [beacon metrics specs PR #14](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-metrics/pull/14):
```
- beacon_custody_groups (Gauge)
- beacon_custody_groups_backfilled (Gauge)
- beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_requests_total (Counter)
- beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_responses_total (Counter)
- beacon_engine_getBlobsV2_runtime_seconds (Histogram)
```
